entries.6f2594f9a467a134: This segment produces vaccines, rapid antigen diagnostic kits, clinical reagents, cancer-treating virus preparations, and other products. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥40,520 million, down 6.3% year on year. The number of infectious disease tests declined after the start of the calendar year, and sales volume of POCT test reagents fell below the previous year. Shipments of influenza vaccines were in line with plans. Effective March 31, 2026, the company made Kainos Co., Ltd., which handles clinical reagents, a consolidated subsidiary through a tender offer.

entries.83e7c19a76814ca0: This is a reportable segment that produces resin and fiber products, including styrene monomer, ABS resin, Poval and sheets for food packaging, and it has the largest sales to external customers among the reportable segments. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥124,161 million, down 8.3% year on year. Selling prices were revised in response to the decline in raw material and fuel prices. Shipments of AS and ABS resins and styrene monomer exceeded the previous year, while sheets for food packaging fell below the previous year as demand recovery was delayed.

entries.d40324cfbab75544: This segment produces fused silica and spherical alumina for semiconductors, electronic circuit boards, acetylene black, electronic packaging materials, and other products. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥104,430 million, up 13.3% year on year. Spherical silica and spherical alumina performed well amid growing demand for AI-related semiconductors, and acetylene black for high-voltage cables also increased.
entries.dd0a7ce82abd0ca5: This segment produces chloroprene rubber, specialty admixtures, fertilizers, calcium carbide, refractories, and other products. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥97,583 million, down 12.6% year on year. Demand for chloroprene rubber was sluggish, and the company has suspended the manufacturing facilities of its high-cost U.S. subsidiary on a temporary basis, without a set end date. Corrugated pipe sales increased, while specialty admixtures fell below the previous year due to construction delays and other factors.
